Container.Name: TwitchMiner
Container.Overview: Watches Twitch streams for you to earn channel points, catch watch streaks, follow raids and claim drops (each drop once). Configured entirely through environment variables, with an optional analytics web page. The first login needs the container console (see the first-run note in the project README).
Container.Changes:
### After 1.1.0 (latest image) - Drops hunt: look for a live channel with drops when nobody on your list is playing a prioritised game (off by default, see Drops hunt). - Fixed games for ended campaigns showing as offered, and the drops sync could stop silently after a failed request.
### 1.1.0 - Prioritise games for drops: tick games on the analytics page, or set Priority games. - Analytics page: drops table, live log panel, green border on the streamers being watched. - Fixed Mine followed channels ignoring its order setting, and failures loading the follow list are now logged. - Docker is the only supported way to run; the Moments option is gone (retired by Twitch).
### 1.0.0 (beta) - First TwitchMiner release.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything the miner writes: cookies, drops database, logs and analytics.

Config.Name: Analytics port
Config.Description: Analytics web page port (needs Enable analytics = true).

Config.Name: Twitch username
Config.Description: Your Twitch username.

Config.Name: Twitch password
Config.Description: Only needed for the first login. Leave empty to be asked in the container console.

Config.Name: Streamers
Config.Description: Comma separated streamers in priority order. Per-streamer overrides: name:follow_raid=false+chat=never

Config.Name: Mine followed channels
Config.Description: Also mine every channel you follow on Twitch (after the streamers above).

Config.Name: Enable analytics
Config.Description: Serve the analytics web page. Set to false to save memory and disk.

Config.Name: Analytics host
Config.Description: Bind address of the analytics page inside the container; keep 0.0.0.0.

Config.Name: Data directory
Config.Description: Folder inside the container for all data; must match the Data path target.

Config.Name: Priority
Config.Description: STREAK, DROPS, SUBSCRIBED, ORDER, POINTS_ASCENDING, POINTS_DESCENDING (comma separated).

Config.Name: Priority games
Config.Description: Comma separated game names to watch first for drops, e.g. Elim,Rust (more can be ticked on the analytics page). Needs DROPS in Priority.

Config.Name: Drops hunt
Config.Description: When a prioritised game has drops and none of your streamers is playing it, look for a live channel with drops enabled and watch it too. Needs Priority games (or games ticked on the analytics page) and DROPS in Priority.

Config.Name: Drops hunt max channels
Config.Description: At most this many hunted channels at a time. One that goes offline is replaced by the next one found.

Config.Name: Claim drops on startup
Config.Description: Claim all drops from the Twitch inventory when starting.

Config.Name: Blacklist
Config.Description: Comma separated streamers to skip (useful with Mine followed channels).

Config.Name: Follow raids
Config.Description: Follow raids for bonus points.

Config.Name: Claim drops
Config.Description: Watch the current game so drops can be claimed.

Config.Name: Watch streak
Config.Description: Prioritise streamers that just went online to catch the watch streak.

Config.Name: Chat presence
Config.Description: IRC chat presence: ALWAYS, NEVER, ONLINE or OFFLINE.

Config.Name: Console log level
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR.

Config.Name: Log time zone
Config.Description: tz database name for log timestamps, e.g. Europe/London.

Config.Name: Discord webhook
Config.Description: Optional Discord webhook URL for notifications.

Config.Name: Discord events
Config.Description: Events sent to Discord (comma separated).

Config.Name: Telegram chat ID
Config.Description: Optional Telegram notifications: chat ID (also set the token).

Config.Name: Telegram token
Config.Description: Telegram bot token.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container time zone, e.g. Europe/London.
